enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Pyrachnid
descriptions: A fire-shrouded melee enemy that ignites heroes on contact.
enemies.behavior: Every surviving contact applies or refreshes its ranked burning damage-over-time stack.

enemies.name: Lightning Stalker
descriptions: Slow-moving long-range orb shooter whose hits can briefly shock.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked projectile carries the authored shock chance and timed stun modifier.

enemies.name: Ray Killer
descriptions: Fires one fast horizontal piercing bolt per target in range and flees when struck.
enemies.behavior: A cast now targets every live hero or companion in range with its own piercing bolt, and an accepted incoming hit queues a navigation-clipped flee before the next volley.

enemies.name: Quadrakiller
descriptions: Fires lightning-orb volleys and becomes exhausted briefly afterward.
enemies.behavior: Its recovered four-shot burst retains the long release/exhaustion interval before the next action.

enemies.name: Molten Crawler
descriptions: Hurls magma at nearby heroes to create damaging lava pools and uses melee close up.
enemies.behavior: Its phase selects per-target retained lava pools or the recovered melee fallback.

enemies.name: Invincitron
descriptions: Orbiting drone fires lasers; owner becomes temporarily invulnerable at half health.

enemies.name: Shielded Grenadier
descriptions: Frontal shield blocks damage; lobs cluster grenades and knocks back close frontal heroes.
enemies.behavior: Directional shield admission, cluster submunitions, and the close bash all use their recovered phases.

enemies.name: Arachno Striker
descriptions: Terrifying slow homing projectile followed by melee pursuit.

enemies.name: Pyro
descriptions: Short fire breath can hit multiple nearby targets.

enemies.name: Laser Unit
descriptions: Charges up, then fires a piercing laser bolt.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked wind-up leads into a range-extended piercing projectile.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech
descriptions: Highly resists Energy damage and fires rapid machine-gun bursts.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist
descriptions: Ground slam knocks nearby heroes upward; repairs itself when damaged.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs fallen robots and uses its tools for melee.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Slows pulled heroes and follows a successful pull with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Pull Modifier retains the three-second slowed presentation and forced movement, then the phase selects the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe.
